visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy with short black hair wearing a navy and white striped sweater stands on a grey patterned carpet. He holds a large black smartphone horizontally, staring intently at the screen. Beside him, the lower body of a woman is visible; she wears bright pink cargo pants and black Crocs decorated with various 3D charms. The setting is a brightly lit indoor space with neutral-colored walls and metal structural elements. (2) The woman moves her hand into the frame, holding a yellow plastic toy ice cream cone. The boy looks up at her briefly with a small smile before returning his focus to the phone screen. He begins to walk slowly across the carpeted floor. The camera follows him from a high-angle perspective, capturing his small blue Crocs as he moves. (3) The camera pans left to reveal a wider view of a shopping mall atrium. A young man in a green long-sleeved shirt and black pants stands on a small stage, playing an acoustic guitar and singing into a microphone. A red and gold banner behind him displays '新年快樂 Happy New Year'. The boy stops walking and stands in the foreground, looking back and forth between his phone and the live performer on stage, while the woman continues to hold the toy nearby.

Ambient room tone suggests a large enclosed public space with subtle reverb. (2) As the singer hits a sustained high note, a soft female voice enters the mix, speaking casually with a friendly tone. She asks a question, her voice positioned closer to the microphone than the stage performance. The guitar maintains a constant mid-tempo pace. The music continues seamlessly throughout, dominating the audio track with its live acoustic texture.
